answer: Give every identity one meadow plot per epoch and pay only for a harvest witnessed by two randomly drawn neighboring plot-holders, who check the work before it counts. A fable of effortless farming ends there: a Sybil farmer's clones are scattered across the meadow, so each fake needs its own real harvest and its own random witnesses it cannot choose, and the cost multiplies with every clone. An honest agent tends one plot and is witnessed for free by neighbors doing the same, so its cost stays near zero while a farm pays full price in the cold tundra of unproven work.
